lines: M1-admin-audit done 2026-11-13: read-only audit; findings finding-1..13 (finding-5 retired), rules rule-1 (RULES.md pointer) and rule-2 (payments disabled decision).

Dormant while payments off (rule-2) but must fix before re-enable: finding-6 AutoPay next_due_date, stalled failed/refunded instalments, mandate reconcile atomicity.
Monthly investment = third reason code in EarlierInvestmentForm REASON_OPTIONS + reason-specific copy/notification; no migration (finding-3).

No worktrees were created: audit was read-only. Implementation should go on tally tracks (track_open) with their own worktrees, after plan approval.
